groups.background: The Sunflag group began in Kenya in the 1930s, when Satya Dev Bhardwaj set up a knitting factory; the group still runs textiles in East Africa (Sunflag Textile & Knitwear Mills, Nairobi). groups.control_summary: Wardha Steel Holding Pte Ltd, Singapore, is promoter of both Evonith Metallics and Evonith Value Steel; it was held 60.1% Nithia and 39.9% CarVal [verified, CARE Nov 2024]. CarVal is reported to have since exited [reported, earlier CRISIL May 2026 note in company file].
groups.background: The Wardha (Bhugaon) complex has two roots. Evonith Value Steel was Lloyds Steel Industries, the R.N. Gupta-promoted Lloyds group's flat steel company (from Gupta Tubes and Pipes, 1970); the Miglani family's Uttam Galva group took 58.35% in December 2012 and renamed it Uttam Value Steels in 2013. Evonith Metallics was Uttam Galva Metallics, the Uttam group's blast furnace unit next door. Both went into insolvency and were bought through NCLT by Nithia Capital and CarVal for about Rs 2,000 crore, completed in January 2021, and rebranded Evonith. The complex now has about 1.29 to 1.4 MTPA of hot metal, earns Package Scheme of Incentives support, and Nithia plans expansion to 3.5 MTPA; it also bought Topworth Urja and Metals for Rs 300 crore [reported].
